purpose: Bounds the deterministic custom-code inventory the project analyzer builds and the migration engine reads. Everything the scan does or refuses to do is declared here rather than hardcoded, so a project can be audited against the rules that produced its inventory.

scope.semantics: Project-owned custom code only. Contributed and vendored code is out of scope by default: its compatibility is package and release metadata, not source inspection.

notes: A file skipped for any reason is recorded with that reason, because a file that was never read cannot support a compatibility conclusion.
Only paths relative to the project root are ever recorded.
